# Supplied sheets

Legacy ornaments cut from six supplied sheets (blue sheet, painted sheet, five painted panels, stencil sheet, tall floral sheet, drawn vector sheet) whose origin was never recorded; grouped by sheet.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `supplied-sheets`, imported, 24 assets.

Artwork: **CC-BY-4.0** ([text](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)). Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

## Use one asset

No version is published yet. Once it is, pin the exact version (never `@latest`); the URL scheme is:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ranx729/ducktape-assets-supplied-sheets@<version>/webp/<asset-id>-<width>.webp
```

Package `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-supplied-sheets`; every file, width and format is listed in its `manifest.json`. Masters live in git under `assets/<id>/` and in `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-supplied-sheets-masters`; never put a master on a page.
